name: form
title: Form
description: A form with consistent rhythm, sections with legends, side-by-side rows and a footer for its actions.

when: Collecting input that is submitted together.

guidance.rule: One primary submit button in the FormFooter.
Mark the exception: required when most fields are optional, optional when most are required.

keyboard.does: Submits the form from a text field.

builtIn: On submit, focus moves to the first invalid field.
FormSection is a fieldset named by its legend.

genui.description: A form. Put fields in the order people fill them and one primary button last. Emits submit with the field values.
